component.name: NetworkTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" end sub
sub runTask() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return
request = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") request.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.InitClientCertificates() request.SetUrl(url) request.AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
if m.top.authHeader <> "" request.AddHeader("Authorization", m.top.authHeader) end if
port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") request.SetMessagePort(port)
if m.top.postBody <> "" sent = request.AsyncPostFromString(m.top.postBody) else sent = request.AsyncGetToString() end if
if sent msg = wait(3000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" and (msg.GetResponseCode() = 200 or msg.GetResponseCode() = 202) m.top.response = msg.GetString() m.top.success = true else m.top.response = "" m.top.success = false end if else m.top.success = false end if end sub
